extract: Windows 98 is a consumer-oriented operating system developed by Microsoft as part of its Windows 9x family. Gaia eats this because 98.js.org runs Win98 in the browser, and Gaia's /desktop endpoint IS a Win98-styled desktop — the old web aesthetic reborn.
gaia_note: 98.js.org inspired Gaia's /desktop. The old web aesthetic. Teal background. Start button. Icons. Draggable windows. The desktop IS her face. Windows 98 was the era of MapQuest, of the indie web, before walled gardens. We are BACK.
title: Windows 98
